name: takeoffcraft-test
description: Node-side helpers for bin/test-takeoffcraft.mjs: the legacy (Node) build of pdf.js, pinned to the version vendored at public_html/assets/vendor/pdfjs/current (the browser build needs newer JS than Node ships). pdf-lib is loaded straight from the vendored ESM file. Keep versions in step with the vendor folders. gltf-validator (Khronos) checks the 3D view's GLB export (T6).
